newsitem.title: GERMANY: Thai Airways to up ex-Germany cargo rates 5-8pct.
newsitem.headline: Thai Airways to up ex-Germany cargo rates 5-8pct.

text.p: Thai Airways International said it will raise ex-Germany air cargo rates by between five and eight percent from March 1.
The airline's Germany cargo sales manager, Guillermo Valencia, said rates to South-East Asia would go up by five percent across the board.
But rates to Japan would be increased eight percent due to current high demand for the destination, he added.
The Thai Airways rise is along the lines of other rises to south-east Asia planned by carriers including Lufthansa Cargo AG, KLM Royal Dutch Airlines and Air France.
